taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-02 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 31374.7 | 20.07 | 20.07
2 | 7559.9 | 12.79 | 32.86
3 | 3573.3 | 1.62 | 34.48
4 | 313.2 | 38.90 | 73.38
5 | 53.6 | 0.41 | 73.79
6 | 22.8 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as K-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-02
Curve type: Q-type (resistivities decrease monotonically with depth — 31374.7 → 7559.9 → 3573.3 → 313.2 → 53.6 → 22.8 Ω·m; this does not match a true K-type signature, which requires a resistivity rise before the terminal decrease. Recommend the file classification be corrected from K-type to Q-type.)
Aquifer depth: ~73.79 m to greater depth (base of Layer 5 into Layer 6, the lowest-resistivity and undifferentiated basal unit; true base not resolved by this sounding)
Recommendation: Plan drilling to penetrate at least several tens of metres into the 22.8 Ω·m basal layer below 73.79 m, as this unit most likely represents the principal water-bearing zone; log lithology carefully through the 313.2 Ω·m and thin 53.6 Ω·m layers above it to confirm the contact before committing to final screen placement.
